firstTranscript.name: Flashbulb Moth, Rut King, The Mountain Lord, The Anaconda Empress

lines.text: 🚨 Flashbulb Moth, Rut King, The Mountain Lord, The Anaconda Empress is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Flashbulb Moth, Rut King, The Mountain Lord, The Anaconda Empress at the door, day 12.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Flashbulb Moth is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Strike the head as it coils — When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap.
🛡️ Ray, Logan, Howard and Ebrahim met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Ray, Logan, Howard are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — Rut King, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
Days later, you'll hear what happened out past the ridge. For now: nothing. The village keeps its face still.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📓 Codex: a cart-driver with flour on their sleeves arrived (trader).
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "We've been thinking. You know things we don't. Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3). We will watch very closely, which is our entire personality."
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
📓 Codex: you've heard of **Scream Cheese**. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Chloe — Social 1. Three offers; they took Scream Cheese. Earned, chosen. (scream_cheese: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Chloe chose Scream Cheese (scream_cheese) at Social 1.
Fireside lesson: Chloe passes around Ginkgo Nut. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Ray: "The muscadine grapes patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
Caleb traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Elif and Logan lingered over the fire together.
Xavier and Calogero lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Rosa takes one look at the full shelves and unshoulders the pack. "Leave the wild standing. Hauling water for the cistern."
🍽️ Tariq carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
📓 Codex: Ebrahim taught Logan Mediation.
📓 Codex: Calogero taught Howard Field Dressing.
🌿 Dandelion — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Dandelion: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🤒 Ray is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
A runner from Thornfield, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
— DAY 13 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. Something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ RUT KING! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Xavier freezes. "What IS that?"
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
(king's hide absorbs 2.)
You STRIKE the king for 9.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 king's Antler Sweep finds you — no dodging it.
Xavier shouts: "Move! MOVE!"
King's Antler Sweep hits you for 15.
📖 Codex: Antler Sweep — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
(king's hide absorbs 2.)
You STRIKE the king for 14.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 king's Antler Sweep finds you — no dodging it.
King's Antler Sweep hits you for 17.
(king's hide absorbs 2.)
king is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the king for 13.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
(king's hide absorbs 2.)
You STRIKE the king for 14.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 Bellow!
King's Bellow hits you for 8.
📖 Codex: Bellow — hits everything close around it. You won't forget this.
(king's hide absorbs 2.)
You STRIKE the king for 11.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 king's Antler Sweep finds you — no dodging it.
King's Antler Sweep hits you for 15.
The Rut King breaks and runs!
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You took a beating that should have ended you — and kept moving. Noted. (Combat track +)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Give it a tree — His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free.
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Ray — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
The stash count is off. 2 stones missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
🌱 Howard waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Howard checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~20 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 Howard pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (1 stone now.)
💧 Ray returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Xavier telling Rosa about Tariq. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
Rosa heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
💧 Caleb returns with water: +4 clean.
👥 Chloe heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
👥 Ebrahim walks out with Chloe. "Nobody walks alone today."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Ray hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
🪵 Ray hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (55 logs now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Ebrahim telling Howard about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Chloe telling Calogero about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
💧 Tariq returns with water: +3 clean.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Logan looks up from the fire. "And now a raid, on top of it all. The options stand — pick, before we lose the chance."
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📋 Ray — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
Xavier hovers near you. "I hate asking. I'm asking anyway — anything to spare?"
💧 Ray returns with 2L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Rosa telling Caleb about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
